The '''Omman system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. It contained the planet [[Omman]]. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], legends told of a [[Unidentified Tionese king|Tionese king]] who had been "buried" on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] adrift within the system. Eventually, someone was able to calculate the starship's location, sending another individual to discover it.<ref name="TH">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|The Tionese Burial Ship}}</ref>
